providers.name: GitHub
providers.help: GitHub search — repos by default. Use qualifier "type:code" for code search, "type:repositories" to stay explicit. Qualifiers: repo:, org:, user:, language:, license:, is:, path:, symbol:, regex. See docs.github.com/en/search-github (code search).

providers.name: Maven Central
providers.help: Java/Maven packages (via search.maven.org Solr API). Direct fetch. Qualifiers: g: (groupId), a: (artifactId), v: (version), p: (packaging), l: (classifier).

providers.name: Wikipedia

providers.name: crates.io

providers.name: PyPI

providers.name: Fetch
providers.help: Fetch any URL and return it as markdown. The query IS the URL (e.g. `fetch https://react.dev`). Cookieless render, no per-site config. Returns markdown in `content`, not `results`.
